scene: The open gondola hums as soapy suds float past towering city bricks.
beats: You squeegee the soapy glass clear, spotting a lightning-catcher spire just as the gondola docks at Rainmaker Rooftops and its metal gate swings wide.
The operator coos cheerfully and presses a damp umbrella token into your hand. The cables lock, and the exit doors slide open.
A tiny clockwork frog springs from the glowing green suds straight into your pocket! The gondola jolts to a halt, opening its doors to the mist.
picture: Flat side view inside the narrow yellow gondola floor. Far left, a foam-caked round porthole. Centre-left, the player leans on his prosthetic leg in orange corduroy. Centre, a pigeon-headed operator grips brass levers. Right, a sloshing bucket glows green. Far right, cables rise upward through open air.
shown: a circular glass porthole covered in thick iridescent foam on the far left
a pigeon-headed operator in yellow overalls steering levers at the centre
a sloshing metal pail glowing with strange luminescent green water on the right

after.label: Stay on
after.beat: You stay put as the gondola glides past the roof, dodging a rogue cloud puff. At the terminus, you hop into a sputtering sidecar motorbike that zips you straight to Midnight Radio Repair.
after.then: Step off at Midnight Radio Repair
